title: AI tool predicts cancer patients' survival chances from a single face photo
script:
A single selfie predicts your cancer survival.
Mass General Brigham researchers just proved your face reveals significant health data.
Dr. Raymond Mak's team used forty million facial photos for training.
This model analyzes subtle changes in facial appearance to determine mortality risk.
They tested the tool on over thirty-eight thousand cancer patients.
The research was published in the journal Lancet Digital Health this month.
The AI uses deep learning to identify traits that human eyes often miss.
It categorized patients into high and low risk groups for mortality.
Would you trust a photo to predict your health?
